深渊的绝对统治者，同时掌握潮与岩两系力量，传说没有任何虾米能在其全力之下存活。: The absolute ruler of the abyss, master of both Tide and Rock. Legend says no shrimp survives its full strength.
据说是最早存在于海洋中的虾米，其身体内蕴藏着创世之初的灵能，所有虾米的祖先。: Said to be the first shrimp in the sea. Creation-era spirit is stored in its body; it is the ancestor of every shrimp.
在深渊混沌能量中诞生的存在，同时具有电与毒两系属性，攻击带来的混沌效果无法预测。: Born from the abyss's chaotic energy, it holds both Electric and Poison. The chaos its attacks leave behind cannot be predicted.
潮系虾米的传说始祖，身上刻有最古老的符文，拥有超越现代虾米认知的战斗能力。: The legendary progenitor of Tide shrimp, carved with the oldest runes, and able to fight beyond what modern shrimp can grasp.
深渊的守护者，用无与伦比的防御力保护着深渊的秩序，曾击退过无数试图破坏平衡的入侵: Guardian of the abyss. Its unmatched defense protects the abyss's order, and it has driven back countless invaders who tried to break the balance.
海洋与深渊力量的完美融合体，其力量足以引发真正的海啸，是整片深渊最强大的存在之一: A perfect fusion of sea and abyss. Its power can raise a true tsunami, and it is one of the strongest beings in the whole abyss.
岩系虾米的传说创始者，其铁甲在数亿年的深渊压力下进化为近乎无敌的状态。: The legendary founder of Rock shrimp. Under hundreds of millions of years of abyss pressure, its iron shell has evolved to near invincibility.
被古代甲录师奉为神明的存在，传说其单次攻击能改变整片海洋的格局。: An existence ancient shell-recorders worshipped as a god. Legend says a single attack can change the shape of an entire sea.
存在于永恒时间中的虾灵，能在己方虾米陷入危机时展现超越时间限制的强大支援力量。: A shrimp spirit that lives in eternal time. When allies fall into crisis, it can give support that outruns the limits of time.
所有毒与疫病的终极来源，据说深渊中的疫病现象正是其存在所散布的余波。: The ultimate source of all poison and plague. The diseases of the abyss are said to be aftershocks of its presence.
统治虚空与现实边界的皇帝，其力量来自两个世界的交汇，任何对它的攻击都可能穿透虚空: Emperor of the border between void and reality. Its power comes from where the two worlds meet, and any attack on it may punch through the void and fall back on the attacker.
全身带电的小型虾米，速度极快，轻微触碰就能给对手留下麻痹后遗症。: A small shrimp charged from head to tail. It is extremely fast, and even a light touch can leave an opponent numb afterward.
背壳上的闪电纹路并非装饰，而是蓄积电能的导体，冲刺时速度惊人。: The lightning marks on its carapace are not decoration but conductors that store charge. When it dashes, its speed is startling.
棘刺中储存着雷电，被攻击时会自动释放电击反伤，令鲁莽的对手吃足苦头。: Its spines store thunder. When struck, it automatically returns an electric shock, and reckless opponents pay for it.
细长的身体充满静电，能精准控制电击的强度，擅长用麻痹拖垮对手。: Its slender body is full of static. It can control the strength of a shock with precision, and is good at wearing opponents down with paralysis.
螯爪储电量惊人，攻击瞬间能以极快速度完成充放电，暴击率极高。: Its claws store a startling amount of charge. In the instant of an attack it can charge and discharge at extreme speed, with a very high critical rate.
能在身体周围建立电磁场，既能为队友加速，也能让对手的动作变得迟缓。: It can raise an electromagnetic field around its body, speeding allies up and slowing opponents down.
能释放雷电波浪，在水中引起连锁放电，对多个目标同时造成伤害。: It can release waves of lightning that chain through the water, damaging several targets at once.
体内物质具有超导特性，能大幅降低对手的行动速度，让己方始终占据先手优势。: Matter inside it behaves like a superconductor. It can sharply slow an opponent and keep its side first on the clock.
电虾进化后速度提升至极限，攻击快得连闪电都追不上。: After evolving from Electric Shrimp, its speed reaches the limit. Its attacks are so fast that even lightning cannot catch them.
蓄积了大量电能的巨螯虾，爆发时能释放出毁灭性的电击冲击。: A giant-clawed shrimp that has stored a vast charge. When it bursts, it can release a devastating electric shock.
两只巨大螯爪蕴藏着惊天雷霆，全力一击的破坏力令所有对手胆寒。: Its two huge claws hold world-shaking thunder. A full-strength blow chills every opponent.
能操控磁场对对手的行动产生干扰，是以控制见长的少见电系虾米。: It can work magnetic fields to interfere with an opponent's movement — a rare Electric shrimp that excels at control.
电系虾米的皇者，速度已达到近乎瞬间移动的程度，其电击来自不可防御的方向。: Emperor of Electric shrimp. Its speed is close to teleportation, and its shocks come from angles you cannot guard.
速度越快伤害越强，在顶峰状态下的一击能抹去一切存在。: The faster it goes, the harder it hits. At its peak, one blow can wipe out whatever stands there.
体型巨大，能释放覆盖整片海域的电浪，是最擅长对多目标输出的电系虾米。: Huge in body, it can release electric waves that cover a whole stretch of sea — the Electric shrimp best at hitting many targets.
在深海裂缝中进化的超级电鳗，攻击穿透力极强，无视所有防御屏障。: A super electric eel evolved in the deep-sea rifts. Its attacks punch through with extreme force and ignore every defensive barrier.
迅电虾进化链终极形态，速度之快已超越光速本身的想象，攻击总在防御之前。: The final form of the Swift Electric Shrimp line. Its speed outruns even the idea of light, and the attack always arrives before the guard.
栖息在热泉中的罕见电系虾米，同时具有温泉的灼烧效果和电击的麻痹效果。: A rare Electric shrimp that lives in hot springs, carrying both the burn of the water and the paralysis of a shock.
在深渊电能裂缝中孕育的强大虾米，速度与力量的完美结合体。: A powerful shrimp born in the abyss's electric rifts — a perfect joining of speed and strength.
电系虾米的终极存在，其电磁场可以影响方圆数里的海域，无法被任何手段屏蔽。: The ultimate Electric shrimp. Its electromagnetic field can reach seas for miles around, and no method can shut it out.
礁石缝隙间最常见的虾米，行动迅捷，是新手甲录师的第一搭档。: The most common shrimp in the cracks of the reef. It moves quickly, and is a novice shell-recorder's first partner.
一对钳子力道十足，喜欢守在礁石边缘等待猎物。: A pair of claws with real force. It likes to wait at the edge of the reef for prey.
随浪花翻腾而生，攻击力惊人但防御薄弱，典型的高风险高收益虾米。: Born in the tumbling spray. Its attack is startling, its defense thin — a classic high-risk, high-reward shrimp.
用海草把自己伪装成礁石，防御能力出众，行动缓慢。: It disguises itself as reef with seaweed. Its defense is outstanding, and it moves slowly.
能制造微型漩涡干扰对手，擅长削弱敌方战斗力而非直接攻击。: It can raise a tiny whirlpool to interfere with an opponent, and is better at weakening a fight than at striking directly.
在深流中以高速连续发起攻击，每次命中都会带走一些敌方的斗志。: In a deep current it strikes in a high-speed chain, and every hit takes some of the enemy's will to fight.
体内盐晶不断结晶，能为队友提供坚固的盐晶护盾，是优秀的支援型虾米。: Salt crystals keep forming inside it. It can give allies a solid salt-crystal shield, and is an excellent support shrimp.
双层贝壳中储存着潮汐能量，越被攻击，反击的力量越强。: Tide energy is stored in its double shell. The more it is attacked, the stronger the counter becomes.
礁虾在深海环境中进化的形态，速度提升到了令人惊叹的程度。: The form Reef Shrimp takes after evolving in the deep sea. Its speed has risen to a startling degree.
龙虾族的精英，蓄势攻击时能掀起小型海啸，防御与攻击都不含糊。: An elite of the lobster line. When it winds up, it can raise a small tsunami, and neither its defense nor its attack is vague.
在暗流中以极速穿行，攻击时仿佛整条鳗都变成了一把利刃。: It threads dark currents at extreme speed. When it attacks, the whole eel seems to become a blade.
凭借深海水压锻炼出的巨大双螯，每一击都带着深海的重量。: Huge twin claws tempered by deep-sea pressure. Every blow carries the weight of the deep.
传说中的翠蓝海马能感知整片海域的潮汐脉动，为同伴提供无与伦比的支援。: The legendary azure seahorse can feel the tide pulse of a whole sea, and gives its companions unmatched support.
身躯如同一座珊瑚礁，几乎无坚不摧，队友站在它身后感到无比安心。: Its body is like a coral reef, almost unbreakable. Allies standing behind it feel completely safe.
在深洋幽暗中诞生，速度快到肉眼难以追踪，攻击来自不可预测的方向。: Born in the dark of the deep ocean. It is too fast for the eye to track, and its attacks come from directions no one can predict.
统治一片海域的潮汐王，全属性均衡且突出，是公认的潮系全能王者。: A Tide King that rules a stretch of sea. Every stat is balanced and high; it is the acknowledged all-rounder of the Tide line.
礁虾进化链的终极形态，速度已超越大多数虾米的理解范畴。: The final form of the Reef Shrimp line. Its speed has already gone beyond what most shrimp can understand.
只在风暴来临时才会现身的稀有虾米，攻击如同风暴一样猛烈。: A rare shrimp that only appears when a storm is coming. Its attacks are as fierce as the storm itself.
据说是深渊某位古老存在的侍从，身上有着远超同类的统帅气质。: Said to be the attendant of some ancient being in the abyss, with a commanding presence far beyond its kind.
深蓝海域的绝对统治者，其一次全力攻击足以改变周边海流走向。: The absolute ruler of the deep-blue seas. One full-strength attack is enough to change the currents around it.
全身棘刺充满剧毒，只需轻轻碰触就能让对手陷入持续中毒状态。: Every spine is full of virulent poison. A light touch is enough to put an opponent into lasting poison.
紫色甲壳中储存着层叠毒素，随着战斗进行，中毒叠层会不断加深。: Layered toxins are stored in its purple shell. As the fight goes on, the poison stacks keep deepening.
能喷射出大范围毒云，在毒云覆盖区域内的所有虾米都难逃中毒命运。: It can spray a wide poison cloud. Every shrimp inside the cloud can hardly escape being poisoned.
分泌的腐蚀液能溶解对手的甲壳，持续降低其防御能力，为后续攻击铺路。: The corrosive fluid it secretes can dissolve an opponent's shell, steadily lowering defense and paving the way for later attacks.
螯爪锋利如刃且布满毒素，每一次命中都有极高概率使对手中毒并造成暴击。: Its claws are sharp as blades and lined with toxin. Every hit has a very high chance to poison and to crit.
透明的身体中充满致幻神经毒素，被触碰的对手会陷入混乱，无法正常战斗。: Its transparent body is full of hallucinogenic nerve toxin. An opponent it touches falls into confusion and cannot fight normally.
能同时传播多种状态异常，接触它的对手往往同时承受中毒、腐蚀和困惑。: It can spread several status ailments at once. Opponents that touch it often take poison, corrosion, and confusion together.
能在水中释放有毒沼气，形成持续伤害的毒性地形，让敌人无处可逃。: It can release poisonous marsh gas in the water, forming damaging toxic terrain that leaves the enemy nowhere to run.
毒棘海胆在深毒环境中进化的形态，毒素强度提升数倍，中毒效果呈指数级递增。: The form Poison-Spine Urchin takes after evolving in a deeply toxic place. The toxin's strength rises several times, and the poison effect grows exponentially.
螯爪分泌的腐化毒素能让对手的防御层层剥落，越打越脆弱。: The corrupting toxin from its claws peels an opponent's defense layer by layer, leaving them more fragile the longer the fight lasts.
能传播类似深渊疫病的毒素，其攻击能给对手附加多种层叠状态异常。: It can spread a toxin like the abyss plague, and its attacks can stack several status ailments on an opponent.
能喷出含有多种毒素的迷雾，同时造成中毒、困惑和腐蚀，控制能力首屈一指。: It can spray a mist of several toxins, causing poison, confusion, and corrosion at once. Its control is second to none.
毒系爆发输出的最强代表，积累足够毒素后能引发毁灭性的毒爆。: The strongest burst attacker of the Poison line. Once enough toxin has built up, it can set off a devastating poison blast.
腐蚀类毒系虾米的王者，其腐蚀毒素能渗透一切防御，对手的抗性在它面前形同虚设。: King of the corrosive Poison shrimp. Its toxin soaks through every defense, and an opponent's resistance might as well not be there.
几乎透明的外表让它难以被察觉，单次攻击携带极强毒素，命中则往往致命。: Its almost transparent look makes it hard to notice. A single attack carries extreme toxin, and a hit is often fatal.
传说中瘟疫的化身，所到之处毒素蔓延，任何虾米都难以在其攻势下维持健康状态。: The legendary incarnation of plague. Toxin spreads wherever it goes, and almost no shrimp can stay healthy under its assault.
毒棘海胆进化链终极形态，其毒素已超越普通生命能承受的极限，碰触即溶。: The final form of the Poison-Spine Urchin line. Its toxin is beyond what ordinary life can bear — touch it, and you dissolve.
毒藻丛林的守护者与统治者，能将整片区域变成充满剧毒的死亡地带。: Guardian and ruler of the poison-algae jungle. It can turn a whole area into a death zone of virulent toxin.
深渊中诞生的毒雾实体，其毒素融合了深渊的腐蚀力与普通毒素，几乎无法被治愈。: A poison-mist entity born in the abyss. Its toxin fuses abyss corrosion with ordinary poison, and is almost impossible to cure.
腐化类虾米的终极领主，其存在本身就是一种腐化场域，任何进入其领域的虾米都会被逐渐: The ultimate lord of corrupting shrimp. Its presence itself is a field of corruption, and any shrimp that enters is slowly eaten away.
全身覆盖厚实岩甲的普通蟹，行动迟缓但防御力出众，是岩系最基础的虾米。: An ordinary crab covered in thick rock armor. It moves slowly but defends outstandingly — the most basic Rock shrimp.
用细小砾石填满体内孔隙，受到攻击时会弹射砾石反击，令对手苦不堪言。: It packs its inner pores with fine gravel. When attacked, it shoots the gravel back, and opponents find it hard to bear.
移动极为缓慢，但其铁质外壳几乎无法被普通攻击击穿，令攻击型虾米头疼。: It moves extremely slowly, but its iron shell can barely be pierced by ordinary attacks, and attacking shrimp find it a headache.
生活在珊瑚礁中，能激活珊瑚刺的共鸣，对靠近的敌人造成持续伤害。: It lives in the coral reef and can wake a resonance in the coral spines, dealing lasting damage to enemies that come close.
含有黄金矿物的螯爪能轻易穿透其他虾米的甲壳，但自身防御较弱。: Claws that hold gold mineral can easily pierce another shrimp's shell, but its own defense is weak.
外壳如同玄武石一样坚硬，能将受到的物理伤害原原本本反弹给攻击者。: Its shell is as hard as basalt, and can bounce physical damage back to the attacker exactly as it came.
体内蓄积着岩浆能量，攻击时会附带灼烧效果，让对手在战斗中持续受苦。: Magma energy is stored inside it. Its attacks carry a burn, and the opponent keeps suffering through the fight.
背壳形如一面盾牌，能为整个队伍提供防御加成，是经典的队伍核心。: Its carapace is shaped like a shield. It can give the whole team a defense bonus, and is a classic core teammate.
石蟹进化后体型大幅增加，甲壳厚度堪比礁石，受到攻击后反击力度惊人。: After evolving from Stone Crab, its body grows sharply. The shell is as thick as reef rock, and the counter after a hit is startling.
铁质外壳坚硬无比，攻击时也会利用铁质螯爪穿透对手防御。: An iron shell of unmatched hardness. When it attacks, the iron claws also punch through an opponent's defense.
体重惊人，重击地面时能引发小型地震，对所有在地面的虾米都造成伤害。: Its weight is startling. A heavy blow on the ground can raise a small quake and damage every shrimp standing there.
专门以坚硬岩石为食，碎岩的力量转化为穿透一切防御的强悍攻击。: It feeds specifically on hard rock. The force of breaking stone turns into a fierce attack that punches through every defense.
水晶甲壳能折射攻击，将一定比例的伤害反射回攻击者，令对手进退两难。: A crystal shell can refract attacks and bounce a share of the damage back, leaving the opponent with no good way forward or back.
岩系虾米公认的王者，体型如同一块巨型礁石，防御力几乎无法被突破。: The acknowledged king of Rock shrimp. Its body is like a giant reef, and its defense can hardly be broken.
栖息在富含矿物质的温泉中，能利用矿泉成分持续恢复自身和队友的生命。: It lives in mineral-rich hot springs, and can use the spring's makeup to steadily restore its own life and its allies'.
栖居在水下火山口的稀有虾米，蓄力攻击能引发小型水下火山爆发。: A rare shrimp that lives at an underwater volcanic vent. A charged attack can set off a small underwater eruption.
巨甲蟹进化链的终极形态，拥有上古岩甲，连深渊的力量都难以穿透。: The final form of the Giant-Armor Crab line. It has ancient rock armor that even the power of the abyss can barely pierce.
自愿守卫深礁领域边界的稀有虾米，对入侵者展现出不妥协的战斗意志。: A rare shrimp that volunteers to guard the border of the deep-reef realm, and shows uncompromising will against invaders.
暗礁区的绝对统治者，其震裂地形的攻击能让整片海底为之颤抖。: The absolute ruler of the dark-reef zone. An attack that splits the ground can make a whole stretch of seabed tremble.
身体内核充满熔融岩石，攻击时能将熔核能量转化为毁灭性的爆碎打击。: Its core is full of molten rock. In an attack it can turn that core energy into a devastating bursting blow.
近乎透明的身体让其难以被发现，擅长利用幻影规避攻击，令对手徒劳出拳。: A nearly transparent body makes it hard to find. It is good at using afterimages to slip attacks, and leaves opponents punching at nothing.
螺壳散发淡淡灵光，能将灵感传递给队友，随机提升其某项属性。: Its shell gives off a faint spirit glow. It can pass inspiration to an ally and raise a random stat.
能将自身变成半透明状态，在战斗中频繁躲避攻击，令对手感到无比沮丧。: It can turn itself translucent and dodge attacks again and again in a fight, leaving the opponent deeply frustrated.
能读取对手的战斗意图，提前预判并规避攻击，同时将情报传递给同伴。: It can read an opponent's intent in a fight, predict and slip the attack, and pass the intel to its companions.
能将随机灵感注入战友体内，虽然效果不可预测，但往往能带来奇迹般的转变。: It can pour a random inspiration into an ally. The effect cannot be predicted, but it often brings a miraculous change.
飘动的触须释放致幻粒子，被接触的对手会陷入梦幻状态，无法区分虚实。: Its drifting tentacles release hallucinogenic particles. An opponent that touches them falls into a dream state and cannot tell false from real.
五条触臂各自感知不同维度的信息，能预知对手的下一步行动并提前规避。: Its five arms each sense information from a different dimension. It can foresee an opponent's next move and slip it in advance.
螯中蓄积着神秘灵能，攻击时带有难以预测的灵能波动，同时保持高度灵活。: Mysterious spirit is stored in its claws. Its attacks carry unpredictable spirit waves, and it stays highly agile.
幽虾进化后可以短暂穿越进入半虚空状态，从对手完全无法防御的角度发动攻击。: After evolving from Shade Shrimp, it can briefly cross into a half-void state and attack from an angle the opponent cannot guard at all.
能制造完美幻觉的稀有灵系虾米，对手在与它战斗时会不断受到幻觉干扰。: A rare Spirit shrimp that can make a perfect illusion. Opponents fighting it are constantly interfered with by hallucinations.
贝壳中封存着远古灵魂的力量，能为队友提供最强大的精神防护，是终极支援型虾米。: Ancient soul-power is sealed in its shell. It can give allies the strongest mental ward, and is the ultimate support shrimp.
身体能反射深海星光，将星光转化为祝福能量赐予全体队友，提升各项属性。: Its body can reflect deep-sea starlight, turn it into blessing energy, and grant it to all allies, raising every stat.
能感知深渊的意志，提前预知深渊中所有敌人的行动，并引导队友规避最强威胁。: It can sense the will of the abyss, foresee every enemy's move there, and guide allies around the strongest threat.
灵系幻影与攻击的完美融合体，在幻影状态下发动的攻击无法被任何防御手段应对。: A perfect fusion of Spirit afterimage and attack. Strikes made in the afterimage state cannot be met by any defense.
传说能微微操控时间流速，在战斗中总能比对手快半步，掌控战斗节奏。: Legend says it can slightly control the flow of time. In a fight it is always half a step ahead, and it holds the rhythm.
来自虚空的稀有虾米，其攻击穿透虚实边界，无法被任何物理防御完全格挡。: A rare shrimp from the void. Its attacks punch through the border of false and real, and no physical defense can fully block them.
幽虾进化链的终极形态，可以完全进入虚空状态移动，攻击时才短暂现形。: The final form of the Shade Shrimp line. It can move fully in a void state, and only briefly takes form when it attacks.
在热泉中凝聚灵力的特殊虾米，能将温泉的治愈力与灵能结合，为队友提供全面恢复。: A special shrimp that condenses spirit in a hot spring. It can join the spring's healing with spirit energy and give allies a full recovery.
在深渊幽暗中诞生的幻影实体，其攻击和防御都在虚实之间，令对手无从应对。: An afterimage entity born in the dark of the abyss. Both its attack and its defense sit between false and real, leaving the opponent no way to answer.
灵系虾米的终极领主，其存在使周围区域的物理法则变得不稳定，在它的领域内，一切攻击: The ultimate lord of Spirit shrimp. Its presence makes the physical laws around it unstable, and inside its domain every attack is void.
